title: Dyson's cross-country drive with Feynman

tellings.quote: driving from Cleveland to Albuquerque and he offered to take me for a ride just to see the country

plain: Sometime between 1947 and 1949, the physicist Richard Feynman was driving from Cleveland to Albuquerque and offered to take a young Freeman Dyson, also a physicist, along for the ride "just to see the country." Dyson tells this in his own words, as a trip he took himself, in an episode about a contractor for the CIA, the US spy agency.
